title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MORNING BRIEF — MARCH 29, 2026**

Bitcoin flatlined at 66.5K while markets convulsed. That stillness is the message.

Technicals screaming: parallel channel connecting COVID lows through 2022 bear bottom to last year's tariff capitulation. Three macro floors across five years forming one structural line. That's not pattern noise—that's geometry. Channel holds, eighty-five thousand isn't prediction, it's math.

But price tells half the story. Psychology tells the other half.
